description: How long savings take to reach a home down payment, from what is saved so far plus the same amount each month growing at a fixed yearly rate, and, with reach_within_months, the monthly amount that reaches it by then, the way SmartFin's down payment calculator does. Returns the down payment, the loan amount it leaves, the months to reach it (within 50 years), the modeled savings split into saved so far, deposits and growth, and the monthly amount (rounded up to a whole currency unit) that reaches it within the chosen time. Use when someone asks how long it takes to save for a down payment, how much a month reaches one by a date, or what a percentage down is on a price. Do not use for how much to put down (it does not say), mortgage approval, closing costs (not included) or the mortgage payment (use smartfin_calculate_loan_payment). The growth rate is held constant, deposits are made at the end of each month and the home price stays the same. Amounts can be in any one currency; none is converted.

currency.description: Currency for the amounts in the summary and the link. Default USD; amounts are never converted

down_payment_amount.description: Down payment as an amount instead of a %; at most the home price. Give this or down_payment_pct

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as % of the price. Give this or down_payment_amount. Default 20. 0 to 100

growth_rate_pct.description: Yearly rate the savings grow at, with compounding included (a savings account's APY in the US, AER in the UK), held the same every year. Default 3, an example, not a current rate. 0 to 20

mortgage_rate_pct.description: Optional: the mortgage rate, % a year, with mortgage_term_years, to suggest the follow-up call for the payment on the loan amount

mortgage_term_years.description: Optional: the mortgage term in years, with mortgage_rate_pct

reach_within_months.description: A time to reach it by, in months, for the monthly amount that does: 48 is 4 years. 0 or omitted for none. 0 to 600

saved_so_far.description: Amount saved toward it today. Default 0. 0 to 100000000

saving_each_month.description: Amount added at the end of every month. Default 0. 0 to 10000000
